hedging_delta.evidence: Similar use of 'we expect'/'anticipate' throughout guidance sections in both calls.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: Cloud optimized silicon target was ~'a couple hundred million' for fiscal 2025 prior; now expected to exceed $200M exiting Q4 and surpass the $800M annual Investor Day target.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New emphasis on TSMC 2-nanometer platform collaboration and April 11 AI investor event, absent from prior call.

tone_delta.evidence: More superlatives like 'record revenue,' 'largest repurchase authorization in our history,' and 'remarkable opportunity' vs prior call's more measured tone.
